description: npm audit: 3 high (tar via @capacitor/cli), 1 high (replace via @trapezedev)
Supabase PAT (sbp_REDACTED...) hardcoded in 3 documentation files — grants full project access
No authentication check — any unauthenticated request can invoke OpenAI calls, consuming API credits and accessing tenant data
No authentication check — accepts any POST with mediaUrl/tenantId, processes media via OpenAI without auth
Webhook secret comparison uses === (string equality) instead of timing-safe comparison — vulnerable to timing attacks
CORS regex /^https:\/\/jurify[-a-z0-9]*\.vercel\.app$/ could match jurify-evil-attacker.vercel.app if attacker creates Vercel project
RBAC enforcement is client-side only — role check reads from profile state, not verified server-side on data access
In-memory rate limiter resets on each edge function cold start — effectively no rate limiting in production
ENCRYPTION_KEY hex value stored in plaintext in project memory file (accessible in repo)
HEALTH_CHECK_TOKEN stored in plaintext in project memory file
KAPSO_API_KEY (full 64-char hex) stored in MEMORY.md — committed to git
Supabase Personal Access Token (sbp_REDACTED...) stored in MEMORY.md — grants full project admin access
CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, COOP, CORP all configured correctly

No eval() or new Function() found in codebase — good
